C gov013.ps-scope OL GOV-013,ARC-027 MUST_NOT ;; Determine what the request needs (backend, frontend, tests, docs, integrations, mapping, containers); do not scaffold optional infrastructure because it may be useful later. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep002.ps-decided-stack OL DEP-002,DEP-011 MUST ;; Use the decided stack; conditional technologies only when their capability is needed now. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-repo-structure OL ARC-027,DEP-022,DEP-023 MUST ;; Create only the required top-level directories and repository-wide files (.slnx, Directory.Build.props, Directory.Packages.props, global.json, .editorconfig, .gitignore, README.md). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.ps-backend-projects OL DEP-024,DEP-008 DEFAULT ;; Create Domain, Application, Infrastructure and Api projects under backend/ targeting the decided platform. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.ps-refs-layout OL ARC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Add only the references of the backend layout; never an outward reference to make compilation easier. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.ps-packages OL DEP-003,DEP-006 MUST ;; Add each baseline package through add-dependency; resolve versions at install time and never copy versions from examples. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.ps-test-location OL DEP-024,TST-011 MUST ;; Create only useful test projects, beside production projects under backend/. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ps-test-project-set EX DEP-024,TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Typical test projects are Application.Tests and IntegrationTests; Domain.Tests only for non-trivial Domain behaviour; Infrastructure.Tests only for a concrete need; Angular unit/component tests stay in the workspace and adopted E2E tests under frontend/<Name>.Web/e2e/. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete test-project set not in the oracle.
C dep014.ps-angular OL DEP-014,DEP-024 DECIDED ;; When frontend scope exists create the workspace under frontend/<Name>.Web/ with the Angular CLI and the decided options. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-internal-dirs OL ARC-027 MUST ;; Create only internal directories the initial implementation needs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf019.ps-dev-persistence OL WF-019,DEP-026,PST-001 MUST_NOT ;; Configure the Development database and seeding entry point; add no Production credentials and no automatic production migration step. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.ps-verify OL WF-005,WF-007,WF-009 MUST ;; Verify scaffolding: restore, build the solution and the Angular app, run relevant tests, run check-dependencies, inspect the tree, confirm usable Development configuration, then verify; never report successful scaffolding for a solution that does not build. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.ps-ref-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; For a Reserved reference change raise a Decision Request with architecture-decision and wait for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ps-ref-marker EX ARC-001,ARC-020 MUST ;; Run an approved reference command (dotnet add/remove … reference, dotnet reference add/remove) with the trailing comment '# project-references: approved'; the hook stops reference commands without it. ;; = ;; none ;; Approval-marker procedure not in the oracle.
C wf007.ps-ref-check OL WF-007,WF-005 MUST ;; After a reference change build the affected projects and run check-dependencies. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.ps-new-assembly OL ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Confirm a new assembly is justified; a new production project is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc027.ps-responsibility OL ARC-027 MUST ;; A new project has an identified architectural or technical responsibility. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc001.ps-min-refs OL ARC-001 MUST ;; Add only the minimum required references, preserving dependency direction. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.ps-shared-config OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Update shared build or package configuration when necessary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.ps-build-test OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build and test the affected solution after adding a project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.ps-reorganize OL GOV-014,RUN-011,WF-001 MUST ;; Reorganizing: inspect tree and references, identify a concrete structural problem, preserve behaviour, move in small reviewable steps, update namespaces/references consistently, avoid unrelated feature work, verify afterwards. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ps-no-forced-template EX GOV-014,GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not force an established project to match this template when doing so provides no concrete value. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov013.ps-not-scaffolded OL GOV-013,ARC-020,ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; MediatR, CQRS trees, VSA, Domain Events, Specifications, SharedKernel, BuildingBlocks, EventBus, messaging, microservices, Kubernetes, cloud projects, state frameworks, Docker files and deployment manifests are not scaffolded by default; each needs an actual requirement and most are Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.ps-completion OL WF-005,ARC-027,ARC-001,DEP-002,GOV-014 MUST ;; Complete when structure matches scope, references respect the architecture, the decided stack is used, no unnecessary projects/directories exist, backend and frontend build, tests pass, Development configuration is usable and nothing unrelated was reorganized. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc027.sl-optional OL ARC-027 MUST ;; Create optional directories and projects only when needed; do not make the repository match the diagram for its own sake. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.sl-backend OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; All backend .NET projects, backend test projects included, live under backend/. ;; = ;; none ;;

C dep024.sl-frontend OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; The Angular workspace lives outside the .NET tree in frontend/<Name>.Web/ and owns its manifests, configuration and sources. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-current-cli-structure EX DEP-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not impose an obsolete Angular directory structure when the current CLI generates a different supported one. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C arc027.sl-docs OL ARC-027 MUST ;; docs/ subdirectories (architecture, decisions, api) are created only when the corresponding documentation exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-global-json EX DEP-008 MUST ;; global.json pins the intended supported .NET SDK line, selecting the current stable SDK of the target release with a rollForward policy allowing patch/feature-band servicing. ;; = ;; none ;; SDK-pinning rule not in the oracle.
C dep008.sl-no-preview-sdk OL DEP-008 MUST_NOT ;; No RC/preview SDK unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C x.sl-editorconfig EX - PREFER ;; Repository-wide formatting/code style lives in .editorconfig; prefer enforceable tooling configuration over restating mechanical formatting rules in instructions. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement preference not in the oracle.
C x.sl-gitignore EX SEC-001 MUST ;; Ignore generated and local artifacts (bin, obj, .vs, node_modules, dist, TestResults, coverage, local secret/config overrides, .claude/.hook-state/); do not ignore files that are part of the Development configuration contract. ;; = ;; none ;; Ignore-list rule not in the oracle.
C gov013.sl-optional-infra OL GOV-013,DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Docker files, deployment manifests, Kubernetes, cloud, messaging and additional services only for a concrete requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;

138 NN ;; Heading.
140 MX [wf020.ss-confirmed-severity,wf009.ss-layer-status,x.ss-static-limits] ;; Completion criteria restating the evidence/severity/status rules above and the stated-limitation extra.

C x.ss-static-limits EX WF-020 MUST ;; The scan is an evidence-based static review, not a penetration test, and cannot prove the application secure; state that limitation in the report. ;; = ;; none ;; Limitation statement not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-concrete OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Report concrete security risks, not generic advice. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-context OL WF-020 MUST ;; Evaluate findings in the context of actual exposure and application behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-confirmed-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Distinguish confirmed findings from items needing verification and assign severity from exploitability, reachability, impact and context, never from a suspicious pattern or raw CVSS alone. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.ss-dev-secrets OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not suppress a real secret because it sits in a Development file. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.ss-no-unneeded OL GOV-013,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require security mechanisms the project does not need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.ss-effective-authz OL SEC-006,SEC-005 MUST ;; Evaluate effective authorization behaviour including global and fallback policies. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.ss-tool-independent OL WF-021 MUST_NOT ;; The review does not depend on a specific MCP server, agent, analyzer, commercial scanner or external tool; available tooling is evidence, not the sole authority. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-scope-surfaces EX WF-020 MUST ;; Inspect which surfaces exist (backend, frontend, auth, data access, integrations, files, containers, CI/CD, production config, logging, caching, background work) and skip irrelevant checks instead of reporting them as failures. ;; = ;; none ;; Scope-determination step not in the oracle.
C x.ss-full-vs-targeted EX WF-020 MUST ;; A full pre-release or requested audit reviews every applicable layer; targeted changes start with the affected layers and expand when the change crosses security boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;; Scan-depth rule not in the oracle.
C x.ss-owasp-fit EX WF-020 MUST ;; OWASP Top 10:2025 is an awareness taxonomy; map a finding only when the category genuinely fits. ;; = ;; none ;; OWASP-mapping rule not in the oracle.
C wf021.ss-scanner-findings OL WF-021,WF-020 MUST ;; When a scanner reports a possible issue inspect the code, decide reachability and relevance, and report only with appropriate confidence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Rate severity from exploitability, exposure, privileges, affected data, blast radius, reliability and compensating controls; never convert advisory CVSS directly without checking relevance. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-severity-scale EX WF-020 DEFINITION ;; Severity scale: Critical (sparingly; immediately exploitable high impact), High, Medium, Low, Info (hardening observation). ;; = ;; none ;; Severity scale not in the oracle.
C x.ss-false-positives EX SEC-006,SEC-009,SEC-008 DEFINITION ;; Not automatically vulnerabilities: endpoints without [Authorize] under a secure fallback, bare [Authorize] when authentication alone is intended, AllowAnyOrigin on a public non-credentialed API, MD5/SHA1 checksums, no app-level encryption when platform encryption suffices, obviously fake test credentials, framework defaults secure in the actual hosting. ;; = ;; none ;; False-positive catalogue not in the oracle.
C sec005.ss-not-safe OL SEC-001,SEC-010,SEC-005 DEFINITION ;; Not automatically safe: secrets in appsettings.Development.json, sensitive values logged at Debug, Angular route guards, hidden UI buttons, CORS as an authorization substitute. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-finding-fields EX WF-020 MUST ;; Every confirmed finding includes severity, file/location, title, evidence, why it is a risk, likely impact, smallest remediation and OWASP category when applicable. ;; = ;; none ;; Finding format not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-needs-verification OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Label uncertain findings NEEDS VERIFICATION instead of presenting them as confirmed; never invent exploitability the code does not establish. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.ss-layer-status OL WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Layer status is PASS, FINDINGS, NOT APPLICABLE or NOT CHECKED; never PASS for a layer that was not inspected. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-remediation EX SEC-008,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Recommend the smallest secure change consistent with the architecture; do not recommend blanket encryption of all fields, security libraries merely to satisfy the scan, or disabling functionality a static scanner cannot understand. ;; = ;; none ;; Remediation discipline not in the oracle.

C wf020.sl-reachability OL WF-020,GOV-014 MUST ;; Do not upgrade packages during a scan unless asked; rate dependency findings from reachability and exposure, not CVSS alone. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.sl-dev-not-exempt OL SEC-001 DEFINITION ;; appsettings.Development.json is not exempt: a real committed secret remains a secret; obviously fake values may be ignored or reported as Info; UserSecretsId is not a secret. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.sl-safe-forms OL SEC-004 DEFINITION ;; Safe forms: EF Core LINQ, parameterized SQL, FromSqlInterpolated where appropriate, ADO.NET/Dapper parameters; normal LINQ predicates with user input are not SQL injection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-command-injection EX SEC-003 PREFER ;; Prefer process APIs that separate the executable from its arguments; validate or constrain external input when command execution is genuinely needed. ;; = ;; none ;; Command-injection guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sl-path-traversal EX SEC-003 MUST ;; Normalize and verify that user-influenced paths remain inside the intended storage boundary. ;; = ;; none ;; Path-safety rule not in the oracle.
C x.sl-deserialization EX SEC-003 MUST_NOT ;; Untrusted payloads are not deserialized into arbitrary runtime types (e.g. BinaryFormatter, unsafe TypeNameHandling). ;; = ;; none ;; Deserialization rule not in the oracle.
C sec016.sl-crypto-passwords OL SEC-016,SEC-008 MUST ;; Security-sensitive MD5/SHA1/ECB, hardcoded keys, custom hashing and home-grown protocols are flagged (not non-security checksums); passwords use established password-hashing facilities, not reversible encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.sl-effective-policy OL SEC-006 DEFINITION ;; Determine the effective policy (fallback/global, attributes, AllowAnonymous, policies, roles/claims, resource authorization); a missing explicit [Authorize] under a secure fallback is not automatically vulnerable. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.sl-anonymous OL SEC-006 MUST ;; Confirm that deliberately public surfaces ([AllowAnonymous]) are intentional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.sl-idor OL SEC-005 DEFINITION ;; Client-side filtering is not authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.sl-token-validation OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Bearer/OIDC validates issuer, audience where applicable, signature/signing authority and lifetime; intentionally disabled validation weakening the contract is flagged. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-no-arbitrary-clockskew EX SEC-017 MUST_NOT ;; Do not demand manually setting every TokenValidationParameters property when authority/metadata configuration already establishes secure validation, and do not impose an arbitrary universal ClockSkew. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec005.sl-angular OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Route guards and hidden/disabled buttons are UX; sensitive operations must be protected by the backend. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.sl-cors OL SEC-009 DEFINITION ;; CORS is a browser-origin policy, not authorization; broad trusted origins, credentialed untrusted origins and environment origins in Production are findings; AllowAnyOrigin can be valid for a public non-credentialed API. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec011.sl-csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; When browser credentials are sent automatically review CSRF protection for state-changing operations; explicit Bearer headers have different CSRF characteristics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.sl-tls OL SEC-007 DEFINITION ;; Disabled certificate validation, accept-all callbacks and plain HTTP for sensitive communication are findings, accounting for TLS termination; missing in-app HTTPS redirection is not automatically a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-rate-limiting EX SEC-013,RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Consider rate limiting where abuse realistically matters (login, password reset, expensive anonymous or resource-intensive endpoints), not on every endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;; Rate-limiting guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sl-response-contracts EX ARC-029,SEC-010 PREFER ;; Returning a Domain entity is not automatically vulnerable (inspect serialized fields), but explicit response contracts are preferable where needed. ;; = ;; none ;; Response-contract preference not in the oracle.
C sec008.sl-data-at-rest OL SEC-008,SEC-016 DEFINITION ;; Match data-at-rest protection to the requirement: one-way hashing for passwords, usually hashing for verification-only tokens, protected storage for retrievable secrets, platform/database encryption when suitable, Data Protection for temporary payloads. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.sl-silent-success OL SEC-013 DEFINITION ;; Not every swallowed exception is a vulnerability, but a security-relevant failure silently turning into success is. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.sl-exploitability OL WF-020 MUST ;; A theoretical missing limit is not automatically High; evaluate whether an attacker can actually exploit it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sl-threat-modeling EX WF-020 MUST ;; When meaningful security-sensitive workflows exist, name them as candidates for threat modeling or manual review instead of claiming the static scan proves them secure. ;; = ;; none ;; Threat-modeling referral not in the oracle.
C wf020.sl-no-mechanical-severity OL WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not map pattern → fixed severity, CVSS → application severity or OWASP category → severity mechanically. ;; = ;; none ;;

91 MX [api016.swagger-accurate,api017.swagger-dev,x.sw-not-test-substitute,api016.sw-auth-metadata,x.sw-client-contracts,gov013.no-speculative] ;; Common-mistakes list restating rule-owned items; Swagger as a substitute for integration tests has no owner clause and is registered.

C x.sw-config-api-layer EX ARC-012 MUST ;; Keep Swagger configuration in the API/composition layer. ;; = ;; none ;; Placement rule not in the oracle.
C dep012.sw-not-openapi OL DEP-012 DECIDED ;; The built-in AddOpenApi()/MapOpenApi() is not a replacement when the requirement is interactive Swagger UI testing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-launch-urls EX WF-006 MUST ;; Keep application URLs and the launch profile in agreement; a launch URL pointing to HTTPS on an HTTP-only port fails. ;; = ;; none ;; Launch-profile consistency not in the oracle.
C api016.sw-accuracy OL API-016 MUST ;; Metadata matches actual responses (not 201 for a 200 endpoint, not 204 for one returning a body); possible responses come from the whole pipeline (binding, validation, auth, rate limiting, exception handling, middleware); merely theoretical statuses are not documented. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.sw-201 OL API-003 DEFAULT ;; For creation document 201 Created with CreatedAtAction/CreatedAtRoute when a canonical URL exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-error-contracts EX API-002,API-016 DEFAULT ;; When failures use ProblemDetails/ValidationProblemDetails describe those contracts where useful. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api008.sw-no-internals OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Keep internal exception types, stack traces, SQL, connection strings and filesystem paths out of Swagger examples and descriptions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-auth-metadata OL API-016 MUST ;; When the API actually uses authentication configure the matching security definition (Bearer scheme for Bearer auth); an installed package alone is no reason for a scheme; global requirements are not applied to anonymous endpoints. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-descriptions EX API-016 DEFAULT ;; Document what helps consumers (preconditions, idempotency, pagination/filtering, meaningful outcomes), not descriptions repeating names; XML comments only when the project chooses them. ;; = ;; none ;; Documentation-content guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sw-multiple-docs EX API-016 MUST_NOT ;; Use several Swagger documents only for a real contract separation (API versions, public/internal surfaces). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api014.sw-generated-clients OL API-014 MUST ;; When the contract drives client generation treat breaking schema changes seriously and keep response metadata accurate. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-client-contracts EX API-016,ARC-029 MUST ;; Avoid unstable anonymous response shapes, use explicit request/response contracts and review generated-client changes when the contract changes. ;; = ;; none ;; Client-contract guidance not in the oracle.
C wf006.sw-verify OL WF-006,API-016,TST-010 MUST ;; After API changes verify Controller behaviour, integration tests and response metadata; start the API when startup/composition changed, open the Development Swagger UI, exercise representative endpoints when meaningful and preserve newly verified behaviour in maintained tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-not-test-substitute EX TST-006 MUST_NOT ;; Swagger is not a substitute for integration tests. ;; = ;; none ;; No owner clause for this item.

C x.tm-one-owner EX - MUST ;; Search for an existing owner of a rule (MAP topic index, repository search) and extend it instead of adding a second statement; other artifacts only point to the owner or check against it with a short check-by-reference item, never rewording the rule. ;; = ;; none ;; One-owner rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-critical-not-in-knw EX - MUST_NOT ;; A critical must/must-not rule never lives only in a knowledge skill or a skill-private reference. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-trigger-role EX - MUST ;; Keep the trigger role: always-loaded policy stays in OP/DEC, path rules stay path-scoped with at least their current scope, workflow obligations stay in workflow steps; do not move content between roles to save tokens. ;; = ;; none ;; Trigger-role rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-header EX - MUST ;; Write each artifact with its one-line 'Kind | Scope | Owner | Loading' header after any frontmatter. ;; = ;; none ;; Header rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-descriptions EX - MUST ;; Knowledge skill descriptions stay concise and trigger-first ('Use when …' with concrete cues). ;; = ;; none ;; Description rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-update-map EX - MUST ;; Update .claude/MAP.md (artifact table, Kind × Scope view, topic index, decision → Affects view) with every instruction change. ;; = ;; none ;; Map-maintenance rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-compact-always-loaded EX - MUST ;; Keep the always-loaded surface (CLAUDE.md, register, skill descriptions) compact; move detail to its owner. ;; = ;; none ;; Context-cost rule (repo/meta).
C x.tm-run-checker EX - MUST ;; Run check-instructions.cjs and fix every reported problem. ;; = ;; none ;; Checker obligation (repo/meta).
C x.tm-exercise-hooks EX - MUST ;; When hooks or scripts changed, exercise them with a sample payload. ;; = ;; none ;; Hook-testing obligation (repo/meta).
C x.tm-summary EX - MUST ;; Summarize what moved, the new owners and the checker result. ;; = ;; none ;; Maintenance output contract (repo/meta).

@scope workflow verify (before declaring implementation complete)
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter (name, routing description).

60 NN ;; Heading.
62 OL [run010.vf-usings]
63 MX [wf004.vf-final-diff,x.vf-final-diff-items,gov003.vf-spec-drift,gov021.vf-stale,tst010.vf-probes] ;; Accidental edits, architecture drift, specification drift, stale CUSTOM_SETTINGS surfaces and unpreserved probes restate WF-004/GOV-003/GOV-021/TST-010; commented-out code, temporary logging, unintended TODO/FIXME markers and stale temporary tests/scripts are added.

C wf003.vf-goal OL WF-003,WF-007 MUST ;; Verification gives evidence the requested change is complete without obvious regressions, matched to scope and risk, without requiring tooling the repository has not configured. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.vf-inspect OL WF-004,TST-010 MUST ;; Before choosing checks review the final changed files and diff: scope match without accidental refactoring, temporary diagnostics/probes removed only after their behaviour is preserved, no generated/build artifacts, no secrets or environment credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.vf-affected-areas OL WF-004,WF-007 MUST ;; Affected areas decide the checks (backend-only, frontend-only, contract/full-stack, documentation-only without unrelated builds). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.vf-build OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build the affected projects; a build failure means the implementation is not complete. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-no-restore EX WF-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use --no-restore unless restore is known to be complete. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf018.vf-build-script OL WF-018 MUST ;; For Angular use the build script package.json actually defines. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.vf-tests OL WF-005 MUST ;; Run the relevant tests and investigate every new relevant failure; never dismiss one as unrelated without checking. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf018.vf-test-script OL WF-018 MUST ;; For Angular inspect package.json and run the configured test script rather than assuming a runner. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-suite-scope EX WF-005 DEFAULT ;; Small solutions run the complete suite; large solutions run affected test projects first, then the broader suite the risk requires. ;; = ;; none ;; Suite-scoping guidance not in the oracle.
C wf006.vf-smoke OL WF-006 DEFAULT ;; For new runnable applications or substantial startup/configuration/persistence/full-stack changes verify Development startup (host starts, endpoint reachable, Swagger UI loads, configuration binds, database initializes, frontend dev server starts, API base URL and CORS compatible); a build alone does not prove runtime composition. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.vf-probes OL TST-010 MUST ;; Behaviour uniquely demonstrated by an ad-hoc/manual probe must be represented by maintained automated coverage before completion unless equivalent coverage exists (confirmed); builds, compiler/formatter/analysis runs and existing suites need no new tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.vf-risk-scoped OL WF-007 MUST ;; Run architecture, formatting/analyzer, dependency and security checks when relevant, not indiscriminately. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.vf-architecture OL WF-007,ARC-001 MUST ;; When boundaries, references, repositories, the EF Core boundary or Unit of Work behaviour changed run check-dependencies and review against the architecture standard. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.vf-seeder OL PST-008 MUST ;; When the model changed confirm the seeder obligation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.vf-format OL WF-007,WF-021 MUST ;; Run dotnet format --verify-no-changes only when configured; do not add a formatter or analyzer just to complete verification; analyzer output is evidence needing context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep004.vf-dep-security OL DEP-004,WF-007,SEC-001 MUST ;; For dependency or security-sensitive changes run vulnerability audits and inspect changed code for secrets, authorization, SQL safety, CORS/TLS changes, sensitive logging and disabled certificate validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run010.vf-usings OL RUN-010 MUST ;; Remove unused/redundant usings in every created or modified C# file (including implicit/global duplicates unless needed); no unrelated repository-wide cleanup; check the changed files rather than assuming the tool removed every import. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.vf-final-diff OL WF-004,GOV-014 MUST ;; Final diff review checks for accidental unrelated edits and architecture drift. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.vf-final-diff-items EX WF-004 MUST ;; Final diff review also removes commented-out code, temporary logging, unintended TODO/FIXME markers and stale temporary tests or scripts. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete diff-hygiene items not in the oracle.
C gov003.vf-spec-drift OL GOV-003 MUST ;; Final diff review checks for unapproved drift from SPECIFICATION.md or CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.vf-stale OL GOV-021 MUST ;; Final diff review checks for stale code, tests, docs or configuration after a CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf008.vf-fix-retry OL WF-008 MUST ;; On failure identify it, make the smallest fix, re-run affected verification (and builds/tests when code changed), repeat until green or genuine user input is required. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf008.vf-no-hide OL WF-008,WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Never hide a known failure or declare completion while one remains; switch to build-fix for stubborn failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.vf-report OL WF-009 MUST ;; Report what was actually run with PASS, FAIL, NOT RUN or NOT APPLICABLE; never imply an unchecked area passed. ;; = ;; none ;;
